From 4322dcde6b4173c2d8e8e6118ed290794263bcc8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Zhengchuan Liang <zcliangcn@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 15:57:17 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] netfilter: ip6t_hbh: reject oversized option lists

struct ip6t_opts stores at most IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR option descriptors,
but hbh_mt6_check() does not reject larger optsnr values supplied from
userspace.

Validate optsnr in the rule setup path so only match data that fits the
fixed-size opts array can be installed. This follows the existing xtables
pattern of rejecting invalid user-provided counts in checkentry() and
keeps the packet matching path unchanged.

`struct ip6t_opts` has a fixed `opts[IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR]` array,
where `IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR` is 16, then off-by-one array access is possible:

[  137.924693][ T8692] UBSAN: array-index-out-of-bounds in ../net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_hbh.c:110:29
[  137.926167][ T8692] index 16 is out of range for type '__u16 [16]'

Fixes: 1da177e4c3f4 ("Linux-2.6.12-rc2")
Cc: stable@kernel.org
Reported-by: Yuan Tan <yuantan098@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Yifan Wu <yifanwucs@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Juefei Pu <tomapufckgml@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Xin Liu <bird@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Zhengchuan Liang <zcliangcn@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Ren Wei <n05ec@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Pablo Neira Ayuso <pablo@netfilter.org>

diff --git a/net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_hbh.c b/net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_hbh.c
index e7a3fb9355ee..450dd53846a2 100644
--- a/net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_hbh.c
+++ b/net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_hbh.c
@@ -168,6 +168,10 @@ static int hbh_mt6_check(const struct xt_mtchk_param *par)
 		pr_debug("unknown flags %X\n", optsinfo->invflags);
 		return -EINVAL;
 	}
+	if (optsinfo->optsnr > IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR) {
+		pr_debug("too many supported opts specified\n");
+		return -EINVAL;
+	}
 
 	if (optsinfo->flags & IP6T_OPTS_NSTRICT) {
 		pr_debug("Not strict - not implemented");
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes an out-of-bounds array access vulnerability in the `ip6t_hbh` netfilter module, where user-supplied `optsnr` values larger than the fixed `IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR` (16) could exceed the `opts[]` array bounds.

The only file modified is `net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_hbh.c`. A new validation is added in the `hbh_mt6_check()` function (the rule setup entry point) to reject `optsinfo->optsnr > IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR` with an error message and `-EINVAL` return. This ensures that only option counts that fit within the fixed-size `opts[16]` array can be installed, preventing the previously reported UBSAN crash and potential out-of-bounds access. The packet matching logic itself remains unchanged.

**Summary of modifications:**
- **File:** `net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_hbh.c`
- **Change:** Added a bounds check for `optsinfo->optsnr` in `hbh_mt6_check()`, returning `-EINVAL` if `optsnr > IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR`.
- **Relationship:** The fix directly addresses the root cause (lack of user-input validation) that allowed the off-by-one array access, and prevents exploitation by rejecting oversized option lists at rule insertion time.

struct ip6t_opts stores at most IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR option descriptors,

fixed-size opts array can be installed. This follows the existing xtables
pattern of rejecting invalid user-provided counts in checkentry() and
keeps the packet matching path unchanged.

`struct ip6t_opts` has a fixed `opts[IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR]` array,
where `IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR` is 16, then off-by-one array access is possible:

[  137.924693][ T8692] UBSAN: array-index-out-of-bounds in ../net/ipv6/netfilter/ip6t_hbh.c:110:29
[  137.926167][ T8692] index 16 is out of range for type '__u16 [16]'

Fixes: 1da177e4c3f4 ("Linux-2.6.12-rc2")
Cc: stable@kernel.org
Reported-by: Yuan Tan <yuantan098@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Yifan Wu <yifanwucs@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Juefei Pu <tomapufckgml@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Xin Liu <bird@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Zhengchuan Liang <zcliangcn@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Ren Wei <n05ec@lzu.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Pablo Neira Ayuso <pablo@netfilter.org>

Here is the root cause:
The `hbh_mt6_check()` function lacked validation of the `optsnr` field from userspace, allowing values larger than `IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR` (16). This caused out-of-bounds access on the fixed-size `opts[IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR]` array in packet matching, leading to a UBSAN crash.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int hbh_mt6_check(const struct xt_mtchk_param *par)
 {
 	const struct ip6t_opts *optsinfo = par->matchinfo;
 
 	if (optsinfo->invflags & ~IP6T_OPTS_INV_MASK) {
 		pr_debug("unknown flags %X\n", optsinfo->invflags);
 		return -EINVAL;
 	}
+	if (optsinfo->optsnr > IP6T_OPTS_OPTSNR) {
+		pr_debug("too many supported opts specified\n");
+		return -EINVAL;
+	}
 
 	if (optsinfo->flags & IP6T_OPTS_NSTRICT) {
 		pr_debug("Not strict - not implemented");
 		return -EINVAL;
 	}
 
 	return 0;
 }
